{{Top|leg}}
The '''D'ian province''' was a territory of the planet [[D'ian]] and the origin of the [[D'ian orchid vine]], as well as other flowers that were judged to be aesthetically pleasing by individuals from one end of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the other.
